work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Opening; Once Upon a Time
definition: The fairy-tale-inspired Magic plane revisited by Wilds of Eldraine, including its wilds beyond the castle walls.
cultural_caution: A fictional plane built from broad fairy-tale genre cues; do not identify it with a real nation, culture, or folklore tradition.

supports: Identifies Eldraine as the plane and describes the set's focus on its wilds.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Once Upon a Time
definition: A curse made by Talion and three witch sisters during the Phyrexian invasion; it put the invaders to sleep but then spread among Eldraine's people.
cultural_caution: A fictional mass-sleep and nightmare premise, not a model of medical sleep conditions or trauma.

supports: Defines the curse's creation, invasion context, and spread.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Sleeping Beauty (Blue-Black), Characters and Story
definition: The fae collective led by Talion, which made the Wicked Slumber through a deal with Agatha, Hylda, and Eriette.
cultural_caution: A fictional Magic affiliation and fae genre category, not a statement about living spiritual traditions.

supports: Names Talion as High Fae leader and recounts the group's deal with the witch sisters.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · The Characters of Wilds of Eldraine
definition: A Magic multiverse-lore status that Will and Rowan are said to have lost after the Phyrexian invasion.
cultural_caution: Source-specific metaphysical lore; it should not be generalized as a real spiritual, psychological, or magical condition.

citations.locator: The Characters of Wilds of Eldraine
supports: States that Will and Rowan lost their sparks after the invasion.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Role Tokens
definition: Predefined Aura tokens with enchant creature; six are created by main-set cards and a seventh is created by a Commander-deck card.
cultural_caution: A gameplay token term. It does not establish a character's narrative social role, identity, or biography.

supports: Defines Role tokens and distinguishes main-set from Commander-deck creation.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Bargain
definition: A set ability allowing an artifact, enchantment, or token to be sacrificed as an additional cost to cast a spell.
cultural_caution: A card-game rule, not a lore event or a claim about a character making a narrative bargain.

supports: Defines Bargain and its additional casting cost.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Adventures
definition: A returning card treatment in which a permanent card has a separate instant or sorcery spell in its lower-left portion.
cultural_caution: A card object and casting procedure, not equivalent to the set story's journey or a character's personal adventure.

supports: Defines Adventure cards and their separate spell characteristics.

work_or_witness: Magic: The Gathering — Wilds of Eldraine · Enchanting Tales
definition: A 63-card bonus sheet of returning enchantments with storybook frames, separate expansion symbol, and set code WOT.
cultural_caution: A product/card-sheet classification, not an additional Eldraine story continuity or a fixed character roster.

supports: Defines the 63-card sheet, set code WOT, and its format-legal distinction.
